CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for **WeatherNode**, a self-hosted website for your personal weather station, maintained by CentauriPrime.
WeatherNode shows live readings, forecasts, radar, history and statistics, and works with Ecowitt, Davis WeatherLink, Weather Underground, Ambient Weather, WeatherFlow Tempest and more.
For questions and bug reports, open an issue at https://github.com/centauri/WeatherNode/issues
